improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try 3 free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered AI assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B trust. Including the price anchor and free searches reduces friction and sets expectations before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant

Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today.
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant for trade/business), establishes the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support), and creates a clear, low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The copy is concise, avoids hype, and speaks directly to the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point: the transition from free trial to paid membership. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining what happens next, reinforces the low entry price, and highlights key benefits they'll gain—reducing uncertainty and encouraging conversion.
